notes.title: HUGE UPDATE COMING IN 2022!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36644281/8559d0aba6d9d1433ff77f123fe9432a7915cf94.png[/img]

[h1]Hey Zombie Hunters![/h1]

[h3]We are excited to announce that [b]Zombie Towns will receive a MASSIVE update in 2022.[/b] We sincerely apologize that the announced update back in summer 2021 didn't make it to Zombie Towns.

In compensation for this, the game will be on sale when our new update comes out, which means more fun for a lower price!

Expected changes:

Zombies will have new sounds!
Cutscenes will be added!
New maps!

And other changes which will be revealed later!

We want to thank everyone who has played our game and stay tuned for the [b]new update![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Bug Fixes (21 June 2021)
notes.content:
[h1]Hey zombie hunters![/h1]

[h2]Zombie Towns got a small bug fix as we have quickly [b]fixed some of the map bugs in the starting map.
[/b][/h2]

[h3]I would like to apologize for the lack of updates that Zombie Towns received. The game will receive some big content updates this summer so stay tuned for that. The reason that we lost this game out of the eye is due to Covid and other personal reasons.[/h3]

[b]As anyways, keep on slaying those zombies![/b]

notes.title: New update (7 march 2020)
notes.content:
[b]Here's a list of changes:[/b]

Ammo is now collectable which means you will no longer pick it up automatically. When close to an ammo cartridge, you'll need to press E to pick the ammo up.

Healing items have been removed.

A new feature is added so whenever you take damage, you will automatically regen your health after some time.

Fixed shadow issues on all maps.



[b]We would like to thank all of our players for playing our game. Stay tuned for future updates.[/b]

notes.title: First update of zombie towns
notes.content:
Here are the most important changes:

The maps of level 1 and 2 have been edited.

All 4 levels have been made easier.

When taking damage from a zombie, there won't be a red screen anymore, unless your HP is under 30.

The heartbeat soundeffect has been removed.

[b]We are still updating this game to make this game better. There will be many updates in 2020. In the future, we will be including some new maps, guns and more. Stay tuned.[/b]
